rtos-layers.title: One API, one backend per scheduler
rtos-layers.alt: Layer diagram: your code uses the C++ wrapper classes, which call the C portability layer of OsAbstraction.h and OsUtility.h, which includes one backend header chosen at build time: FreeRTOS, ThreadX, CMSIS-RTOS2, or the no-RTOS backend for host tests.
rtos-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your code uses the C++ classes (listed from include/*.h). Every class calls the C portability layer, the OS_* types and os_* functions of OsAbstraction.h and OsUtility.h, and nothing else. That layer includes exactly one backend header from include/os/, chosen by a compile definition (read from the table in OsAbstraction.h); with no definition the no-RTOS backend is used, for host tests and bare metal. The backend is the only code that names a kernel.
